video_title: Jason Sudeikis Sold His Jordan Tickets Trying to Make It in Chicago

quotes.speaker: Jason Sudeikis
quotes.summary_phrase: Jason Sudeikis sold his Michael Jordan tickets to pay rent
quotes.excerpt: I sold them to pay rent. I scalped them to pay rent.
quotes.quote: My dad got me tickets to the Sacramento Kings versus the Bulls in 98. It would have been Jerry West and White Chocolate, but then also a championship team. I sold them to pay rent. I scalped them to pay rent. I never got to see them.

quotes.speaker: Jason Sudeikis
quotes.summary_phrase: Why Chicago is the best place to develop comedy skills
quotes.excerpt: I think you go there to get better at doing what you do versus being seen.
quotes.quote: I think people move to Chicago to get better at doing what you do versus being seen for what you can do. I think going to New York or LA, there are lots of places that are ready to snatch you right up and take you as is, versus Chicago, there is more of a work ethic instilled in you and it almost beats the smart-ass or the bullshit out of you.

quotes.speaker: Jason Sudeikis
quotes.summary_phrase: Jason Sudeikis on Jason Williams' practice habits
quotes.excerpt: Anything that he did in a game he had practiced over and over and over.
quotes.quote: I love that clip that I see all the time for some reason with Jason Williams where he is talking about anything that he did in a game he had practiced over and over and over. I felt the same way with jokes. Even though you are improvising, there is something that I have been in this space before and you are just catching up with it.

quotes.speaker: Jason Sudeikis
quotes.summary_phrase: Tina Fey's influence on Sudeikis's career at SNL
quotes.excerpt: Tina Fey was on the main stage then she got hired away by Adam McKay.
quotes.quote: When I first moved to Chicago, Tina Fey was on the main stage then she got hired away by Adam McKay, who was head writer at SNL. She would go write on SNL. Just to go write. And so we overlapped for a month. But again, at that point I was just a student and I was taking classes and when you take classes you get to watch the shows for free if they got space.

quotes.speaker: Jason Sudeikis
quotes.summary_phrase: Sudeikis's work ethic and dedication to watching comedy
quotes.excerpt: I would tell them I cannot come in until noon because I am out until 12.
quotes.quote: Any real job I had, I would tell them I cannot come in until noon because I am out until 12. I was not drinking or anything at that point. I was not partying at all. It was just about I want to go and watch shows until they are done. And then it was not even about hanging out because if you did not drink, people would ask you too much why you are not drinking.
